priority: lists (sum of list weights, cap 16) + companies (12*(1-exp(-sum(companyWeight*freq/8)/15))) + recent (2.5*log2(1+reports) + 0.25*min(8, reports since 2025)); -1 Hard outside core lists, -1 acceptance < 30% outside core lists, -0.5 non-LeetCode

levels.SDE2: standard for mid-level / most product-company rounds
levels.SDE3: harder or specialised - senior rounds, Google/Meta hard, or 'light' topics

groups.title: Arrays & Hashing
groups.cue: Unsorted array/string and you need lookups, counts or running totals in O(n)
groups.template: Trade memory for time: hash map/set, prefix totals, or one running best

subgroups.title: Hash lookup & counting
subgroups.cue: "Have I seen X / its complement / its anagram before?"
subgroups.template: One pass; map value->index or value->count; check before insert

variants.title: Complement lookup (two-sum family)
variants.cue: Pair whose sum/difference hits a target, array unsorted
variants.template: For each x look up target-x in map, then store x

variants.title: Frequency counting
variants.cue: Compare multisets, find most/least common, anagram checks
variants.template: Count array[26] or map; compare or scan counts

variants.title: Group by canonical key
variants.cue: Bucket items that are "equivalent" (anagrams, shifts, patterns)
variants.template: Map canonical form (sorted string / count tuple / offsets) -> list

variants.title: Set membership & sequence starts
variants.cue: Existence questions, longest consecutive run without sorting
variants.template: Put all in set; only start counting from x where x-1 is absent

subgroups.title: Prefix sum
subgroups.cue: Many range-sum queries, or "count subarrays whose sum/xor/balance = K"
subgroups.template: P[i]=sum of first i; sum(l..r)=P[r+1]-P[l]; store prefix counts in a map

variants.title: Static range sum (1D/2D)
variants.cue: Immutable array, many sum(l,r) queries
variants.template: Build P once, answer each query O(1); 2D uses inclusion-exclusion

variants.title: Subarray sum equals K family
variants.cue: Count/longest subarray with sum K, sum divisible by K, equal 0s/1s; negatives allowed so no window
variants.template: map[prefix]=count (or first index); ans += map[prefix-K]

variants.title: Prefix/suffix products & passes
variants.cue: Answer for i depends on everything left and right of i
variants.template: Left pass then right pass, fold into one output array

variants.title: Difference array (range updates)
variants.cue: Many "add v to range [l,r]" then read final values
variants.template: d[l]+=v, d[r+1]-=v, prefix-sum at the end

variants.title: Prefix XOR / parity
variants.cue: Subarray XOR = K, or even/odd counts of characters
variants.template: Same as prefix sum with xor; bitmask of parities as map key

variants.title: Prefix / suffix max (or min)
variants.cue: Each index needs the best value to its left AND to its right
variants.template: leftMax[i], rightMax[i] in two passes; often two pointers replace both arrays

subgroups.title: Kadane / running best
subgroups.cue: Best contiguous subarray (max sum/product), or best buy-then-sell
subgroups.template: cur=max(x,cur+x); best=max(best,cur); keep min too for products

variants.title: Maximum subarray sum
variants.cue: Largest sum of a contiguous slice
variants.template: Kadane; circular = max(kadane, total - min-kadane)

variants.title: Maximum product subarray
variants.cue: Products with negatives and zeros
variants.template: Track both max and min ending here; swap on negative

variants.title: Running min/max (single transaction)
variants.cue: Best pair i<j of arr[j]-arr[i]
variants.template: Keep min so far, update best difference

subgroups.title: Index as hash / cyclic sort
subgroups.cue: Values are in 1..n (or 0..n) and O(1) extra space is required
subgroups.template: Place value v at index v-1 by swapping, or mark visited by negating

variants.title: Cyclic sort placement
variants.cue: Find missing/duplicate numbers in range 1..n
variants.template: while a[i]!=a[a[i]-1] swap; then scan for mismatches

subgroups.title: In-place rearrangement
subgroups.cue: Rotate, permute or rearrange in place with O(1) space
subgroups.template: Reverse tricks, scan from the right for pivot, vote counters

variants.title: Reversal tricks
variants.cue: Rotate by k, next lexicographic arrangement
variants.template: Rotate = reverse all, reverse parts; next permutation = find dip, swap, reverse suffix

variants.title: Boyer-Moore majority vote
variants.cue: Element appearing more than n/2 (or n/3) times in O(1) space
variants.template: Candidate+counter; cancel pairs; verify at end

subgroups.title: Single pass & simulation
subgroups.cue: "Just do what the statement says, in one pass" - no hidden structure
subgroups.template: Walk the array once, keep the few running values the rule needs; simulate step by step

groups.title: Two Pointers
groups.cue: Sorted array/string, pairs/triplets, palindromes, or in-place compaction
groups.template: Two indices moving toward each other or in the same direction; each moves at most n times

subgroups.title: Opposite ends
subgroups.cue: Sorted input, look for pair/triplet meeting a target, or symmetric checks
subgroups.template: l=0,r=n-1; move the side that cannot be part of a better answer

variants.title: Pair sum on sorted array
variants.cue: Pair with a target sum on sorted data, closest pair
variants.template: Sort; fix i, two-pointer the rest; skip duplicates

variants.title: Container / trapped water
variants.cue: Area between two bars, water between heights
variants.template: Move the shorter side inward; track leftMax/rightMax

variants.title: Palindrome check
variants.cue: Is it a palindrome (after cleanup / one deletion)?
variants.template: Compare s[l],s[r]; on mismatch try skipping one side

variants.title: Count pairs below target
variants.cue: Count pairs/triplets with sum < or <= target, triangle sides
variants.template: Sort; when a[l]+a[r] fits, all between count: ans+=r-l

variants.title: k-sum: triplets / quadruplets with dedup
variants.cue: All distinct triplets / quadruplets with a target sum, or the closest sum
variants.template: Sort; fix k-2 elements with loops (skip equal neighbours), two-pointer the rest, skip duplicates at both levels

subgroups.title: Same direction (read/write)
subgroups.cue: Remove/dedupe/compact in place, or merge two sorted sequences
subgroups.template: slow = write index, fast = read index

variants.title: Remove / dedupe in place
variants.cue: Delete items in place and return new length
variants.template: Copy a[fast] to a[slow] when it should be kept

variants.title: Partition (Dutch national flag)
variants.cue: Group values into 2-3 classes in one pass
variants.template: lo/mid/hi pointers; swap into regions

variants.title: Merge two sorted sequences
variants.cue: Combine or compare two sorted arrays/strings
variants.template: Pointer per input; take the smaller; fill from the back when merging in place

groups.title: Sliding Window
groups.cue: Contiguous subarray/substring with a size limit or a condition you can grow/shrink monotonically
groups.template: Expand right; while window invalid shrink left; update answer

subgroups.title: Fixed-size window
subgroups.cue: Window length k is given
subgroups.template: Add a[r], drop a[r-k], update answer once r>=k-1

variants.title: Fixed window sum/average
variants.cue: Max/min sum or average of every length-k slice
variants.template: Running sum

variants.title: Fixed window frequency match
variants.cue: Find anagrams/permutations of a pattern inside text
variants.template: Count map of pattern vs window; track matches count

variants.title: Fixed window max/min
variants.cue: Max of every window of size k
variants.template: Monotonic deque of indices (see stack.monotonic-deque)

subgroups.title: Variable-size window
subgroups.cue: Longest/shortest substring satisfying a condition that breaks monotonically
subgroups.template: Two indices; counts in map; shrink while invalid (longest) or while valid (shortest)

variants.title: Longest valid window
variants.cue: Longest substring with no repeats / at most k changes / at most k zeros
variants.template: Shrink while invalid; ans=max(ans,r-l+1)

variants.title: At most K distinct
variants.cue: Longest run with at most K different values
variants.template: Count map; shrink while map.size()>K

variants.title: Shortest covering window
variants.cue: Smallest window containing all required items or reaching a sum (positive numbers)
variants.template: Grow until valid, then shrink while still valid and record

variants.title: Exactly K via atMost(K)-atMost(K-1)
variants.cue: Count subarrays with exactly K distinct/odd/ones
variants.template: count(exactly K)=atMost(K)-atMost(K-1)

variants.title: Count all valid windows
variants.cue: Number of subarrays with product<K / containing all of something
variants.template: For each r add (r-l+1) or l after shrinking

groups.title: Binary Search
groups.cue: Sorted/rotated data, or a yes/no predicate that flips once as the value grows
groups.template: lo/hi on index or answer space; keep the invariant; lower_bound style loop

subgroups.title: Classic & bounds
subgroups.cue: Find target / first or last occurrence / insert position
subgroups.template: while lo<hi: mid; if pred(mid) hi=mid else lo=mid+1

variants.title: Exact match
variants.cue: Is x in sorted array?
variants.template: Standard loop, careful mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2

variants.title: Lower / upper bound
variants.cue: First/last position, insert position, integer sqrt
variants.template: First index where pred is true

subgroups.title: Rotated sorted array
subgroups.cue: Sorted then rotated; find min or target
subgroups.template: Compare mid with hi (or lo) to know which half is sorted

variants.title: Search / min in rotated array
variants.cue: Rotation point unknown
variants.template: One half is always sorted; check if target lies inside it

subgroups.title: Binary search on the answer
subgroups.cue: "Minimise the maximum" or "maximise the minimum"; checking a guess is easy (greedy) but choosing is hard
subgroups.template: lo..hi over answer values; feasible(mid) greedy check; monotone

variants.title: Minimise the maximum
variants.cue: Speed/capacity/largest part so that the task fits in D days/k parts
variants.template: Smallest mid where greedy(mid) <= limit

variants.title: Maximise the minimum
variants.cue: Place items so the closest gap is as big as possible
variants.template: Largest mid where greedy placement succeeds

variants.title: K-th smallest by counting
variants.cue: K-th smallest in a sorted matrix / pair distances / multiplication table
variants.template: Search value v; count(<=v) with two pointers; find first v with count>=k

subgroups.title: Search in 2D matrix
subgroups.cue: Sorted rows (and columns)
subgroups.template: Treat as flat array, or staircase from top-right

variants.title: Flat index or staircase walk
variants.cue: Rows sorted and chained, or rows+cols sorted
variants.template: idx -> (idx/cols, idx%cols); staircase moves left/down

subgroups.title: Predicate on unsorted / structural property
subgroups.cue: Peak, single element in pairs, any condition that splits the array
subgroups.template: Decide which side must contain the answer from mid and neighbour

variants.title: Peak / mountain
variants.cue: Local maximum, bitonic array
variants.template: Go toward the larger neighbour

variants.title: Pair-index parity
variants.cue: Every element twice except one, sorted
variants.template: Check mid parity against its pair

subgroups.title: Partition two sorted arrays
subgroups.cue: Median / k-th of two sorted arrays in log time
subgroups.template: Binary search cut in the smaller array so left halves balance

variants.title: Median of two sorted arrays
variants.cue: Two sorted arrays, log(min(m,n)) required
variants.template: Cut i in A, j=half-i in B; check cross conditions

subgroups.title: Search over timestamped records
subgroups.cue: Get latest value at or before time t
subgroups.template: Per key list of (time,value) appended in order; upper_bound

variants.title: Floor lookup on appended list
variants.cue: Versioned/timestamped reads
variants.template: upper_bound(t)-1

groups.title: Linked List
groups.cue: Pointer manipulation on singly/doubly linked nodes, O(1) extra space
groups.template: Dummy head, prev/cur/next, fast/slow pointers; draw the pointers before coding

subgroups.title: Fast & slow pointers
subgroups.cue: Cycle, middle, k-th from end, or a function sequence that may loop
subgroups.template: slow+=1, fast+=2; meet => cycle; reset to head to find entry

variants.title: Cycle detection / entry (Floyd)
variants.cue: Does it loop? where does the loop start? also f(x) sequences
variants.template: Meet, then move one pointer to start, step both by 1

variants.title: Middle split
variants.cue: Middle node, palindrome list, split for merge sort
variants.template: When fast reaches end, slow is middle

variants.title: K-th from end (gap pointers)
variants.cue: Remove/return n-th node from the end in one pass
variants.template: Advance lead by n, then move both

subgroups.title: In-place reversal
subgroups.cue: Reverse whole list, a sub-range or k-groups
subgroups.template: prev=null; while cur: next=cur.next; cur.next=prev; prev=cur; cur=next

variants.title: Reverse whole list
variants.cue: Reverse list (iterative and recursive)
variants.template: Three-pointer loop

variants.title: Reverse a range / k-group
variants.cue: Reverse between positions, in pairs, in groups of k
variants.template: Dummy; find node before range; reverse k nodes; reconnect

variants.title: Reorder / rotate
variants.cue: Interleave first half with reversed second half; rotate by k
variants.template: Middle + reverse + merge; or make ring and cut

subgroups.title: Merge, split & rebuild with dummy
subgroups.cue: Build a new list from pieces: merge, partition, add digits
subgroups.template: Dummy head + tail pointer; append nodes

variants.title: Merge sorted lists / sort list
variants.cue: Combine sorted lists, sort a list in O(n log n)
variants.template: Merge two; merge sort with middle split

variants.title: Partition / filter / digit add
variants.cue: Split by predicate, remove values, add numbers stored as lists
variants.template: Two dummies (less/greater) or carry loop

variants.title: Align two lists
variants.cue: Intersection node of two lists
variants.template: Switch heads when a pointer hits null; they meet at intersection

subgroups.title: Deep copy & multilevel
subgroups.cue: Copy with random pointers, flatten child lists
subgroups.template: Old->new map, or interleave copies then split

variants.title: Copy with extra pointers
variants.cue: Each node has an extra pointer to copy
variants.template: Hash map old->new, or weave A A' B B'

groups.title: Stack & Queue
groups.cue: Nested structure, matching pairs, "previous/next element that is bigger/smaller", undo/cancel
groups.template: Push while it may still matter; pop when a new element resolves it

subgroups.title: Matching & cancelling
subgroups.cue: Brackets, adjacent duplicates, collisions
subgroups.template: Push opens; pop on matching close; stack top is the "pending" item

variants.title: Bracket matching
variants.cue: Validate or repair parentheses
variants.template: Stack of opens (or of indices for removal)

variants.title: Adjacent cancel / collisions
variants.cue: Remove adjacent pairs, asteroid collisions, star removal
variants.template: Compare with top; pop while it cancels

subgroups.title: Monotonic stack
subgroups.cue: Next/previous greater or smaller element, spans, areas bounded by smallest bar
subgroups.template: Keep stack increasing/decreasing; when popped, the new element is the answer for the popped one

variants.title: Next greater / smaller element
variants.cue: For each item, distance to or value of next bigger/smaller (also circular)
variants.template: Decreasing stack of indices; loop 2n for circular

variants.title: Largest rectangle (histogram)
variants.cue: Max area under bars; max rectangle of 1s in a matrix
variants.template: Increasing stack; on pop, width = i - newTop - 1

variants.title: Contribution of each element
variants.cue: Sum over all subarrays of min/max
variants.template: For each i, count subarrays where it is min: left*right from prev/next smaller

variants.title: Greedy removal with stack
variants.cue: Smallest number after removing k digits, smallest subsequence of distinct letters
variants.template: Pop while top > current and removals left

subgroups.title: Monotonic deque (queue)
subgroups.cue: Max/min of a moving window, or best value within last k positions
subgroups.template: Deque of indices; pop back while worse; pop front when out of window

variants.title: Window max/min
variants.cue: Sliding window maximum; dp with best of last k
variants.template: Decreasing deque

variants.title: Shortest subarray with prefix deque
variants.cue: Shortest subarray with sum >= K, negatives allowed
variants.template: Increasing deque of prefix sums

subgroups.title: Expression evaluation & parsing
subgroups.cue: Calculator, RPN, nested encoded strings, path simplification
subgroups.template: Operand stack (+ operator stack or sign); push context on '(' or '['

variants.title: Postfix / RPN
variants.cue: Evaluate tokens in reverse polish order
variants.template: Push numbers; pop two on operator

variants.title: Infix calculator
variants.cue: +,-,*,/ and parentheses in a string
variants.template: Keep last operator; push signed numbers; * and / fold into top; recurse or stack on '('

variants.title: Nested decode / path stack
variants.cue: k[encoded] strings, Unix path normalisation
variants.template: Stack of (count, partial string) or of directory names

subgroups.title: Stack simulation & implement
subgroups.cue: LIFO order is the whole problem: push/pop replay, build a stack/queue
subgroups.template: Replay the operations on an explicit stack; check the invariant after each step

groups.title: Heap / Priority Queue
groups.cue: Repeatedly need the current smallest/largest, top K, or merge of many sorted streams
groups.template: Min/max heap; keep size K; push next element from the stream you popped

subgroups.title: Top K elements
subgroups.cue: K largest/smallest/most frequent/closest
subgroups.template: Size-K min-heap for largest (or quickselect / bucket sort)

variants.title: K-th largest / smallest
variants.cue: Single k-th value, or stream of adds
variants.template: Min-heap of size k; top is answer

variants.title: Top K frequent
variants.cue: Most common K items
variants.template: Count map then heap of size K or bucket by frequency

variants.title: K closest
variants.cue: K nearest points / values to x
variants.template: Max-heap by distance of size K, or binary search window

subgroups.title: Two heaps
subgroups.cue: Running median, or split items into a lower and upper half
subgroups.template: Max-heap low half, min-heap high half; rebalance sizes

variants.title: Running median
variants.cue: Median after each insertion / in a sliding window
variants.template: Balance sizes; lazy deletion for windows

variants.title: Unlock-then-pick
variants.cue: Choose best among items that become available as a resource grows

subgroups.title: K-way merge
subgroups.cue: K sorted lists/rows, need global order or smallest range

variants.title: Merge K sorted
variants.cue: Merge many sorted lists
variants.template: Heap of heads

variants.title: Smallest range across K lists
variants.cue: One element from each list, minimise max-min

subgroups.title: Greedy scheduling with heap
subgroups.cue: Simulate time, always pick most urgent/largest, or replace worst choice later

variants.title: Repeatedly take the largest

variants.title: Event / CPU simulation

variants.title: Regret (undo worst choice)

subgroups.title: Merge & insert

variants.cue: Union of ranges

variants.title: Intersect two lists

variants.title: Any overlap?
